newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks post record gain in bullish trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks post record gain in bullish trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks made a record 5.82 percent jump in extremely bullish session on Saturday which analysts said resulted from growing demand in a market short of securities.
"The government is luring investors without much initiative to improve the supply position," said a market analyst.

The Dhaka Stock Echange all-share price index rose 5.82 percent or 104.09 points to 1,890.36 on a turnover of 259.2 million taka. Of the 103 issues traded, 81 closed up, 20 ended down and two were unchanged.
Apex Foods gained 730.83 to 8,325.26, Monno Fabrics rose 10.43 to 137.14 and Beximco Pharma was up 9.36 to 200.20.
